summary.en: Women's health and neuropsychiatry anchor development, supported by biosimilars and generics. Public materials identify a small set of named clinical candidates amid many unnamed portfolio projects.
summary.zh: 女性健康和神经精神疾病是研发的支柱，并辅以生物类似药和仿制药。公开资料在众多未具名产品组合项目中仅明确了少数已命名的临床候选药物。

ind.zh: 更年期症状；美国NDA已获受理

ind.en: Bipolar depression and generalized anxiety disorder
ind.zh: 双相抑郁和广泛性焦虑障碍

watch.en: Vraylar royalties reached HUF189 billion in the first nine months of 2026.
watch.zh: 2026年前九个月，Vraylar特许权使用费达1890亿匈牙利福林。

watch.en: Company strategy explicitly targets managing cariprazine loss-of-exclusivity effects through new CNS assets.
watch.zh: 公司战略明确以新的中枢神经系统资产应对cariprazine独占期结束的影响。

watch.en: Estetrol's US application has been accepted; a decision date was not verified.
watch.zh: Estetrol的美国申请已获受理；未核实到决定日期。

watch.en: Nine-month free cash flow before M&A reached HUF223 billion.
watch.zh: 并购前前九个月自由现金流达2230亿匈牙利福林。

sources: AbbVie partner pipeline: ABBV-932 mechanism and modality

gaps: Only three distinct named clinical/registration assets were verified; many pipeline-chart projects are unnamed. No complete company phase totals were verified.
RGH-202 target and modality remain unverified. The H1 report identifies it as Richter's standalone compound in social anxiety disorder; the November pipeline supplies Phase 2 status.
Estetrol discovery origin and future milestone dates for all selected assets remain unverified.
The original-research page dates to March 2025, before June 2026; current named-asset stages come from November 2026 presentations.
